pages.heading: Two Newfoundland oil programs: the supplement and Oil to Electric

transcript: Your oil rebate just doubled! Newfoundland and Labrador's Home Heating Supplement.
Who gets the full $1,000? Families who earned $100,000 or less in 2025. Earned up to $150,000? You get at least $400.
What you need: you pay for the oil yourself, with bills for at least 250 litres bought in 2026. Keep them!
Already applied? Don't apply again. Already paid? A second payment is coming later this year.
Two ways to apply: online, or with a paper form by mail. The last day is January 15, 2027. Late forms are not accepted.
Want to quit oil for good? Oil to Electric can pay up to $22,000 for a heat pump. It is a different program, for lower-income homes.
Here is how to apply: homepowerrebate.com/nl-oil
